estimatedFields: the arrival at the 200 m parking point: CGTN gives it as 'after entering the orbit for around six hours' (orbit insertion is about ten minutes after launch); it is drawn at 6:00:00 after launch
the end of the stop at the parking point (12 min before the docking) and the start of the closing (30 min before the turn ends)

the U-turn: CGTN says the craft goes to the front and turns round, and that it reached the 200 m parking point, but not in which order; it is drawn turning before it parks. Where it passes, how far ahead and below, and when it turns (8 min before it parks) are not in a source either
the docking time is to the minute (07:54 UTC); it is drawn as the contact, and the latching after it (8 min) is an estimate, as is the ring's 0.3 m travel
the approach path, the closing speed and every camera move
Tianhe's section lengths, the small section's and resource cabin's 2.8 m, the wing width (5.2 m, from 67 m2 a wing over its 13 m) and where the wings stand
the docking ring's size and its petals on Shenzhou and on Tianhe

provenance.l: People's Daily: Shenzhou-12 launched 9:22 Beijing time (01:22 UTC), docked with the front docking port of Tianhe at 3:54 pm Beijing time (07:54 UTC), about 6.5 hours; a complex with Tianzhou-2
Wikipedia: launch 17 June 2021, 01:22:31 UTC; docking 07:54 UTC on Tianhe's forward port
Space.com: docked with Tianhe at 0754 GMT, 17 June

CGTN: 'has to first go to the front, take a U-turn and then dock on the front of the space station'; 'reached the parking point 200 meters away from the space station's core module, ready for docking after entering the orbit for around six hours'
